title: Walking the line: Nifty, Sensex trade steady as Indian IT stocks defend global bloodbath
description: Indian stock indices remained relatively steady on Friday, extending their winning streak to a seventh session as sustained foreign inflows and low direct AI exposure cushioned the impact of a major tech sell-off on Wall Street and Asian markets. While US and Asian equities plunged due to fears of tougher artificial intelligence regulations and rising Brent crude prices, domestic benchmarks like the BSE Sensex and Nifty 50 drew strength from strong Q2 earnings. Mahindra & Mahindra spearheaded the market rally following stellar quarterly results, and Indian IT companies gained traction as investors sought alternative destinations away from heavy AI hardware. Bharti Airtel also traded positively despite mixed financial reports, demonstrating overall domestic market resilience.
